items.question: Why does drying take much longer?
items.answer: Blocked filters/condenser, weak heating or humidity sensor faults are common causes. Common service areas include the city center, Khimshiashvili, New Boulevard, Boni, Airport area and Gonio.

items.question: Is cleaning enough?
items.answer: It can be if airflow is blocked; internal ducts, fan and sensors still need checking when errors persist.

items.question: Is lint inside a dryer risky?
items.answer: Yes. Excess lint restricts airflow and can increase overheating risk.
